adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin_group_route.js`, `setupController` now does `controller.set("model", model); model.findMembers();` without returning/chaining the promise (and `setupController` is not a hook Ember waits on). Previously `afterModel` returned `model.findMembers()`, so a rejection would abort/bubble through the route’s promise chain. With the new code, the transition completes even if the AJAX request fails, and the rejection is not observed by the route (no error substate), leaving `model.members`/`user_count` unset and no surfaced error to the admin.
